description.it: Come è cambiata l'abilità attuale dei giocatori del club tra un import e l'altro.
description.en: How the club's players' current ability changed between imports.

widgets.sql: SELECT i.game_date AS date, a.name AS series, a.ability_current AS value FROM players_all a JOIN _imports i ON i.status = 'ok' AND i.import_id >= a._import_id AND (a._valid_to IS NULL OR i.import_id < a._valid_to) WHERE (a.uid, a.birth_date) IN (SELECT uid, birth_date FROM players WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 6) ORDER BY date

SELECT name, age, ca_first, ability_current AS ca_now, ability_current - ca_first AS ca_change, first_seen FROM (SELECT p.name, p.age, p.ability_current, (SELECT a.ability_current FROM players_all a WHERE a.uid = p.uid AND a.birth_date = p.birth_date ORDER BY a._import_id LIMIT 1) AS ca_first, (SELECT i.game_date FROM players_all a JOIN _imports i ON i.import_id = a._import_id WHERE a.uid = p.uid AND a.birth_date = p.birth_date ORDER BY a._import_id LIMIT 1) AS first_seen FROM players p WHERE p.club_uid = :club) ORDER BY ca_change DESC
